summary: Maintains interaction expectation strategies, interactive prototypes and documentation, with isolated candidate exploration and adoption.
runtime_notes: The Agent invokes managed-case mode only when the current dynamic gap needs interaction facts; the skill returns an evidence-backed fact_result and standalone mode remains available.

Candidate artifacts stay in the domain _explorations directory; return unresolved choices without asserting stable fact updates or writing Case State. Existing user decisions authorize adoption; never infer approval from implementation.
